params.command:
$sw=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridge\switch-v3.ps1'; $log=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridge\switch-v3.log'; $body=@'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 8
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$bootstrap=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo\heaven-bridge\bootstrap.ps1'
$log=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridge\switch-v3.log'
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $bootstrap *> $log
exit $LASTEXITCODE
'@; Set-Content -Path $sw -Value $body -Encoding UTF8; Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',('"{0}"' -f $sw)); Write-Output ('V3_SWITCH_SCHEDULED script=' + $sw)
